items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Before I did anything I played with Wardell Gray, that was one of my first jobs, so I worked all over town with him.

ctx.x: You’ve led a pretty boring life haven’t you?

No I’ve had a great life, I really have had a great life. Before I did anything I played with Wardell Gray, that was one of my first jobs, so I worked all over town with him. Then Earl Bostic, I worked a lot with him. And he was a great player, kind of different than jazz, but—
Yeah, kind of rhythmy and bluesy.
